brief:
Democracy Now! correspondent Amy Goodman reported from Berlin on Germany's crackdown on pro-Palestine protests, which the government justifies through Staatsräson—a doctrine of "reason of state" that prioritizes unconditional support for Israel. The policy has led to restrictions on pro-Palestine speech and assembly in the country.

A lawyer known as "Berlin 4" discussed the legal implications of the crackdown with Goodman, addressing how German law enforcement has applied the doctrine to limit Palestinian solidarity activism.
dek: Democracy Now! 's Amy Goodman is in Berlin, Germany, this week, where the crackdown on pro-Palestine speech is shaped by the German policy of Staatsräson , or “reason of state.”
title: Germany enforces "reason of state" doctrine to suppress pro-Palestine speech
